Kazuki Miyamura is a visiting research student with the CCWJ from July 2025, joining from the Program of Mechanical Engineering at Hiroshima University in Japan through Hiroshima University's ECBO (Engineers Cross Borders) / Joint Research Program. His work focuses on wire arc additive manufacturing of carbon steel.

Kazuki was interested in joining the CCWJ because of its expertise in welding physics, additive manufacturing, and computer vision.

Outside of work, Kazuki enjoys running, language learning, and traveling.

####### Prior Degrees

Mechanical Engineering (ongoing), Hiroshima University, Japan
